Name: ClayMap
Author: theunderscore76
Description:
Pretty basic tile overlay mod that shows clay locations with depth.

Adds two SMAPI console commands:

- show clay # of hoes forward
[code]claymap_setdepth #
[/code]
- toggle showing the overlay
[code]claymap_toggle[/code]

Downloads.Description:
Adding suggestions by PianoAddict
* Remove the 0 on "current" tiles
* Ensure default is set to current tile
* Added support for winter forage grids (snow yam + winter root)
* Added support for generous enchant
